thresholdNote: A MAJORITY OF EIGHT IS FIVE. Four decides nothing, because the other side can reach four too.
claimCancelledLine: {{name}} was CANCELLED (the placement was wrong; it does NOT go to the opponents)
claimLostLine: {{name}} went to the opponents (team {{team}}) — they held at least one card
askRules: To ask: AN OPPONENT ONLY / you must hold a card of that half-suit / A CARD YOU DO NOT HOLD / the target must still have cards
promptHelp: a <seat> <1-4> <1-13> ... ask / c <half> <seat x6> ... claim (you place all six cards)
gameDrawn: Game over. Cancellations left it level, so nobody wins.
askHit: The ask succeeded. You keep the turn
askMiss: A miss. The turn passes to the player you asked
claimWon: Claim made. Your team takes the half-suit
claimCancelled: CANCELLED. All six were with your team but you misplaced them. It does NOT go to the opponents
claimLost: An opponent held at least one, so the half-suit goes to them
result.cpuWin: Game over! The other team wins.
result.draw: Game over. It ended level, so nobody wins.
